guessing-text-widths.why: Fixed: box widths are now set from real `getComputedTextLength()` measurements of each node's actual label and sub-label text in a live browser (max text length + 28px padding, rounded), not eyeballed. Re-measured after the fix: every box has 28-30px of real slack over its longest string, and every box stays within the SVG viewBox with no clipping.

one-fixed-label-coordinate-per-mark.why: Labels are on hand-placed static boxes, not an auto-layout/force-directed diagram, so there is no dynamic label-placement problem this guards against.

shrinking-required-text-to-fix-collision.why: The one real overlap/overflow bug found (a CSS grid track not shrinking below content width on mobile) was fixed with `minmax(0,1fr)` and `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, not by shrinking any font size.

desktop-layout-scaled-blindly-to-mobile.why: Mobile gets a distinct layout (compact horizontal abstraction strip replacing the sticky diagram), verified with an actual 390px screenshot -- which is also where the grid-overflow bug was caught.

mixing-source-derived-phrases-with-inter.why: Fixed the two real instances found on audit (grepped every quotation mark in narrative prose): step 2 used quotation marks around an invented illustrative example ('make a graph'), which could read as a literal instruction pulled from the repo -- reworded to say plainly it's a made-up example and switched to italics. The capstone's paraphrased concern kept quotation marks alongside the hedge 'in effect', which fought that hedge -- dropped the quotation marks and added an explicit note that the literal concern string is elsewhere on the page. All other quoted/coded text (the hero attribution, JSON snippets, the 'unclassified' field value) is genuinely verbatim and already distinguished by a blockquote or code styling.

putting-full-semantic-prose-inside-visua.why: SVG node marks hold only 2-4 word labels; full explanatory prose lives in the narrative column, never inside a mark.

using-an-expert-explorer-as-the-default-.why: Page opens in guided/banner mode with the diagram tracking scroll position, not dropped straight into an unscaffolded free-explore state.

calling-progressive-disclosure-a-lesson-.why: The page never calls itself a lesson, and the 9-step sequence it does claim is real and ordered.

lesson-deck-with-static-diagrams.why: The diagram is interactive (clickable nodes, live highlight state), not a static image in a slide deck.

interaction-bolted-on-after-the-explanat.why: Path-highlighting and click-to-navigate are the explanation's core mechanism, built in from the first draft, not layered on afterward.

replacing-the-primary-visual-object-at-e.why: One persistent SVG (or strip, on mobile) stays mounted for the whole page; only its highlight classes change per step.

free-form-practice-controls-that-permit-.why: No constructive-practice or manipulation feature was built at all.

revealing-the-destination-before-the-lea.why: No prediction-before-reveal mechanic exists; the use case set learning.predictionBeforeReveal to false.

correctness-only-feedback-with-no-semant.why: No assessment/quiz mechanic exists on the page.

calling-guided-task-completion-evidence-.why: The page makes no claim that scrolling through it proves understanding; there is no assessment claim at all.

no-critical-text-text-overlap.why: Correction: the original 'satisfied' here was a screenshot-only check, and it was wrong -- getBBox() measurement later found every node-label/node-sub pair overlapping by ~0.73px, invisible at screenshot zoom. Fixed by widening the label/sub baseline gap; re-measured with getBBox() and confirmed a real +4.27px gap at every one of the 10 nodes, not eyeballed.

no-critical-text-node-overlap.why: Same manual screenshot check as text-text overlap; node boxes and their own labels stay contained.

no-clipped-required-labels.why: Same manual check; this is also the category the one real bug fell into (mobile grid overflow clipping narrative text), which was found and fixed before publish.

no-required-controls-offscreen.why: Banner dismiss button and stage strip chips confirmed visible in both the 1280px and 390px screenshots.

minimum-readable-font-size.why: Fixed: .node-label raised to 12px and .node-sub to 11px (SVG-to-screen scale remains ~1.02, so this is the real rendered CSS size), both now inside this repo's own 11-13px diagramming guidance. Re-measured after the fix in a live browser.

edge-label-clearance.why: No text elements with class edge-label were actually drawn (checked by grep) -- the CSS rule for it is dead code. Relationship semantics live in the narrative prose, not on the trace line.

arrowhead-clearance.why: Only one arrowhead exists in the whole diagram (end of the trace, entering the final node); confirmed clear of the node box in screenshots.

balanced-whitespace.why: Subjective, checked by eye against both screenshots; no gross imbalance.

focal-hierarchy.why: Active node is visually dominant (amber glow + border), upcoming nodes are dimmed to 45% opacity; verified visually in both themes.

stable-layout-across-steps.why: Scrolling and clicking only toggle CSS classes on existing elements; container geometry does not reflow between steps, checked by scrolling through and re-screenshotting.

first-frame-legibility.why: Hero heading, lede, and stat row are all visible and legible in the first viewport on load with no scroll or interaction required.

narrative-visual-synchronization.why: Verified by dispatching a click on the 'primitives' diagram node and confirming the matching narrative step received the is-active class.

persistent-object-continuity.why: Same diagram/strip DOM node persists across the whole page; it is never removed and re-created between steps.

manipulation-consequence-legibility.why: The only interaction is navigational (click jumps and highlights); there is no rule-probe or constructive manipulation this check is meant to cover.

first-run-does-not-require-expert-explor.why: Guided banner plus scroll-driven default state walks a first-time reader through without requiring them to explore anything.

terms-are-defined-before-first-use.why: Spot-checked each of the 9 steps: model, concern, heuristic router, semantic view/projection, candidates (with substitute/complement defined inline), ViewSpec (defined as 'a contract'), visual primitives, implementation, and output are each defined in the sentence that introduces them.

one-new-semantic-distinction-per-instruc.why: Each of the 9 numbered steps introduces exactly one new pipeline concept, by construction.

likely-wrong-readings-are-explicitly-dis.why: Added explicit one-line disambiguation for the four terms most likely to be misread out of context: 'heuristic router' (not a network router), 'candidates' (representation patterns, not people/UI elements), 'ViewSpec' (a plain JSON object this repo defines, not a product or standard), and 'visual primitives' (not language primitives like int/string). Did not attempt to disambiguate every possible misreading -- these four were chosen because each name overlaps a much more common meaning in software.

novice-can-read-a-simple-example-before-.why: The whole page is one concrete worked example (the concern 'explain what Representation Router is') carried through every stage, before any reference to the wider 23-pattern catalog.

expert-reference-mode-is-separate-from-g.why: Dismissing the banner switches to an explore mode where any stage can be opened directly, out of order, separate from the default guided scroll path.

observed-user-confusions-become-regressi.why: No one has actually used this page yet, and there is no regression-case mechanism for it at all. Not applicable yet, but genuinely not done.

direct-manipulation-produces-an-explanat.why: No direct-manipulation feature exists; clicking a node navigates, it does not manipulate the model.

abstraction-levels-remain-linked-to-the-.why: The page has a single abstraction level; no linked caricature/detailed toggle was built.

if-scaffolding-fade-is-present-core-acce.why: Scaffolding fade only changes banner text/visibility; node tabindex, role=button, and Enter/Space keyboard handlers remain present regardless of guided/explore state.
